output.summary: exec-relay, claude-controller and runner-models stop paths now send their group SIGKILL through a shared signalGroup (command.ts), which repeats a successful SIGKILL every 20 ms until kill fails or 250 tries on a ref'd timer, as runCommand did; SIGTERM steps stay one-shot and in place. New fork-race tests per path failed first (exec-relay 3/3, claude-controller 3/3, runner-models 3/3), then GREEN 3/3 each; command tests on the shared fixture still fail on bf3f31c, c6c67e4, 6ab8aa2 and pass 6/6 x3; 25 related files 364/364; typecheck exit 0.

Independent read-only review of 43c81f1: With fixes. Critical 0. signalGroup and all four call sites correct, stop sequences kept, RED confirmed for all three new tests and an unref mutation caught by the two separate-caller tests. Important 1: solutions doc still lists the three call sites as open and points at the old code. Minor 2: runner-models test margin depends on ten serially started shim copies. Minor 3: note requalification in the PR.

evaluation.feedback: implement: update docs/solutions/runtime-errors/macos-fork-escapes-one-shot-process-group-sigkill.md (follow-up resolved via signalGroup, current line refs, why forkLoop uses kill -9) and make the runner-models fork-race test use one binary in ten homes so no loop can end before the kill.
